description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterCommand01]{Command Flash Mob}

Blaster gains a +1 status bonus to AC only while within 60 feet of the thrall emitting @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraGrd01]{Guard Aura}. The benefit ends when the aura ends, at the start of his next turn, or if the thrall is destroyed or removed.
